findings.fix: Add a generic `kostantToralBracketRootSubgroupPoints` (the matrix image of `kostantBracketRootSubgroupParam`) and the relation `[x_i(t), x_j(u)] = x_[i,j](tu)` at the `kostantToralRootSubgroupPoints` level. Then define `geckAdjacentRootSubgroupPoints` by specialising it, as `geckRootSubgroupPoints` does, and drop `matrix_rootParam`, `commutator_mul_one` and `commutator_add`.
findings.issue: The private lemmas `commutator_mul_one` (line 80) and `commutator_add` (line 101) contain the same `Units.map (LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv …)` transport proof. That transport is generic, because `geckRootSubgroupPoints` and `geckPoints` are just generic `kostantToralRootSubgroupPoints` and `kostantToralPointsSubgroup` with Geck data plugged in. The sum-root subgroup is also defined as a commutator instead of as the image of `kostantBracketRootSubgroupParam`.

summary: The generic bracket subgroup and its commutator relation are at the right level, but the step into the matrix carrier is done only for the Geck case, twice, and is supported by two public theorems that are special cases of the general relation. Lift the carrier-level construction to the generic `kostantToralRootSubgroupPoints` layer and derive the Geck version from it.
